name: Job listing pill row
notes: Reuses the FAQ accordion's .faq-item markup as an <a>, overridden into a pill by .cc-listing.
No department grouping, no ATS iframe, no empty state on the live page — 3 roles published as a flat Webflow collection list, each an outbound link opening in a new tab.

CASCADE: .faq-item is also .w-inline-block here. The display fix must win on SPECIFICITY (a.faq-item, .faq-item.w-inline-block). The earlier bug rendered the pills inline-block at 160px instead of 120px with the arrow on the wrong side.
